why: Violations that already existed when scripts/glb-contract-guard.mjs landed (2026-09-05, task glb-export-contract-and-validator, Astra F-ASTRA-8). Grandfathered so the guard can turn the board red on NEW breakage today instead of waiting for a 69-asset art pass.
law: PAY DOWN BY DELETING ENTRIES, NEVER BY REGENERATING. Fix the asset, delete its line, and the guard stays green. There is deliberately no --write-baseline flag. The guard also fails on a STALE entry (one whose violation no longer occurs), so a fix cannot be landed without deleting its line.
